stages.name: setup
stages.description: pull codellama:7b-code-fp16 (the model the embedding script requests); CodeT5-base snapshot; re-score the shipped predictions

steps.name: codet5_snapshot
steps.cmd: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download as s; print(s('Salesforce/codet5-base', local_dir='{RESULTS}/codet5-base'))"

stages.name: retrieve
stages.description: per dataset: unzip, IR retrieval, CodeLlama-7B embedding retrieval (Ollama), hybrid alpha=0.5 (README steps)

steps.name: prepare
steps.cmd: W={WORK}/{dataset}; mkdir -p {WORK} && rm -rf $W && cp -r {REPO}/RetriGen $W && cd $W/dataset && unzip -oq {dataset}.zip && if [ -n "${SMOKE_ROWS:-}" ] || [ {SMOKE} = 1 ]; then for f in {dataset}/*.csv; do head -n 300 $f > $f.tmp && mv $f.tmp $f; done; fi && python {HPC}/glue_retrigen.py prepare $W {dataset}

steps.name: ir
steps.cmd: cd {WORK}/{dataset}/IR && mkdir -p result/{dataset}/codebase_train_query_{train,test,val} && sh codebase_train_query_train.sh && sh codebase_train_query_test.sh && sh codebase_train_query_val.sh

steps.name: embed_retrieval
steps.cmd: cd {WORK}/{dataset}/codellama && mkdir -p result/{dataset}/codebase_train_query_{train,test,val} && sh codebase_train_query_train.sh && sh codebase_train_query_test.sh && sh codebase_train_query_val.sh

steps.name: hybrid
steps.cmd: cd {WORK}/{dataset}/hybrid && mkdir -p result/{dataset}/{train,test,val} && sh test_alpha_0.5.sh && sh train_alpha_0.5.sh && sh val_alpha_0.5.sh

stages.name: finetune
stages.description: per dataset: fine-tune CodeT5-base 75 epochs (run-RetriGen.sh), predictions, accuracy (RQ1 acc.py) and CodeBLEU

steps.name: train_test
steps.cmd: cd {WORK}/{dataset} && mkdir -p results saved_models && sed -i 's/--epochs [0-9]*/--epochs {EPOCHS}/' run-RetriGen.sh && sh run-RetriGen.sh

steps.name: score
steps.cmd: python {HPC}/glue_retrigen.py txt {WORK}/{dataset} {dataset} && cd {REPO}/RQ1/evaluator && python acc.py --label_file {WORK}/{dataset}/result/{dataset}/RetriGen_Label.txt --result_file {WORK}/{dataset}/result/{dataset}/RetriGen_Result.txt | tee {RESULTS}/work/{dataset}/acc.txt
